title: First Steps with Jesus
subtitle: Ten days for a new beginning: who Jesus is, and how to walk with Him.
forWhom: For anyone new to following Jesus

days.title: You are loved
days.word: Before you did anything, God loved you enough to give His Son. This is where everything begins: not your effort, but His love.
days.step: Say quietly: "God, thank You for loving me." He hears you.

days.title: Who is Jesus
days.word: Jesus is not merely a teacher. He is God, come near, full of grace and truth, to bring you home.
days.step: Read John 1:1-14 slowly. Underline one line that stays with you.

days.title: A new life
days.word: In Christ you are a new creation. The old is gone. You do not have to earn this; you receive it.
days.step: Name one old thing you are ready to leave behind, and give it to Him.

days.title: Grace, not earning
days.word: You are saved by grace, through faith. It is a gift. You cannot fail your way out of what God freely gave.
days.step: Rest today in this: you are accepted, right now, as you are.

days.title: Talking with God
days.word: Prayer is simply talking with your Father. No special words are needed, only an honest heart.
days.step: Talk to God for one minute, out loud, like a friend.

days.title: The Word
days.word: The Bible is how God speaks and steadies your steps. A little, every day, changes everything.
days.step: Open the Bible in the app and read one psalm.

days.title: The Holy Spirit
days.word: You are not alone. The Spirit of God lives in you, to comfort, teach, and lead.
days.step: Ask: "Holy Spirit, lead me today." Then watch for His nudges.

days.title: The family
days.word: You were not made to walk alone. God sets you in a family, to be carried and to carry others.
days.step: Join one community, or share one prayer with the family.

days.title: Forgiveness
days.word: When you fall, you do not run from God; you run to Him. He is faithful to forgive and to cleanse.
days.step: Confess one thing honestly to God, and receive His mercy.

days.title: Tell someone
days.word: The most natural thing about new life is to share it. You do not need all the answers, only your story.
days.step: Tell one person: "Something is changing in me. I am following Jesus."

title: Learn to Pray
subtitle: Seven days through the prayer Jesus taught, one line at a time.
forWhom: For anyone who wants prayer to feel real

days.title: Our Father
days.word: Prayer begins with belonging. You come not to a distant power but to a Father who is near.
days.step: Begin: "Father." Sit with that one word for a moment.

days.title: Hallowed be Your name
days.word: Before asking, we worship. Naming who God is puts everything else in its place.
days.step: Name three things God is (good, faithful, near) and thank Him for each.

days.title: Your kingdom come
days.word: We ask God to have His way, on earth as in heaven, starting in us.
days.step: Pray for one place where you long to see God move.

days.title: Give us this day
days.word: God cares about your daily bread. Bring Him the ordinary needs, not only the crises.
days.step: Ask God plainly for one thing you need today.

days.title: Forgive us
days.word: We ask forgiveness, and we extend it. Mercy received becomes mercy given.
days.step: Forgive one person, even quietly, and ask God to forgive you.

days.title: Lead us
days.word: We ask for protection and guidance, admitting we cannot walk it alone.
days.step: Ask God to lead you through one hard thing ahead.

days.title: Amen, and abide
days.word: Prayer is not a task to finish but a friendship to keep. Stay close, and keep talking through the day.
days.step: Pray the whole Lord’s Prayer slowly, then stay quiet for one minute.

title: Walk Through Mark
subtitle: Sixteen days, a chapter a day, through the fastest-moving Gospel.
forWhom: For anyone ready to read a whole Gospel

days.title: The beginning
days.word: The good news bursts in: the Kingdom is near, and Jesus is calling.
days.step: Read Mark 1. Note how urgently the story moves.

days.title: Authority
days.word: Jesus forgives sins and eats with sinners. Grace scandalizes the religious.
days.step: Read Mark 2. Who does Jesus welcome?

days.title: Opposition
days.word: The crowds press in; the leaders push back. Jesus makes a new family.
days.step: Read Mark 3.

days.title: Parables
days.word: The Kingdom grows like a seed, hidden, slow, and sure.
days.step: Read Mark 4. Which soil are you?

days.title: Power over chaos
days.word: Storm, demons, sickness, death: nothing is beyond His reach.
days.step: Read Mark 5.

days.title: Bread in the wilderness
days.word: Jesus feeds thousands and walks on water. He is more than a prophet.
days.step: Read Mark 6.

days.title: The heart
days.word: Defilement is not outside but within. Jesus reaches the far-off.
days.step: Read Mark 7.

days.title: Who do you say I am
days.word: The turning point: to follow is to take up a cross.
days.step: Read Mark 8. Answer His question yourself.

days.title: Transfigured
days.word: Glory revealed, and the honesty of "I believe; help my unbelief."
days.step: Read Mark 9.

days.title: The cost and the call
days.word: The rich man walks away; blind Bartimaeus follows. The Kingdom belongs to the childlike.
days.step: Read Mark 10.

days.title: The King comes
days.word: Jesus enters Jerusalem and cleanses the temple. The confrontation begins.
days.step: Read Mark 11.

days.title: The greatest command
days.word: Love God, love neighbor. The widow gives her all.
days.step: Read Mark 12.

days.title: Watch
days.word: Jesus speaks of the end, and of staying awake and faithful.
days.step: Read Mark 13.

days.title: Betrayed
days.word: The Last Supper, Gethsemane, the arrest. He is handed over for us.
days.step: Read Mark 14.

days.title: The cross
days.word: He is crucified. The curtain tears. "Truly this was the Son of God."
days.step: Read Mark 15 slowly, and give thanks.

days.title: He is risen
days.word: The tomb is empty. Go and tell. The story is only beginning.
days.step: Read Mark 16. Tell someone the good news today.

title: Meet Jesus
subtitle: Six days through the heart of the Gospel: who Jesus is, and why He came for you.
forWhom: For anyone wanting to know Jesus

days.title: God so loved
days.word: The whole story begins in love. God did not send His Son to condemn you, but to rescue you. You are wanted.
days.step: Read it aloud, putting your own name where it says "the world".

days.title: The Word made flesh
days.word: Jesus is God come near, full of grace and truth. He did not stay far off; He moved into the neighborhood of our pain.
days.step: Underline one line that surprises you about who Jesus is.

days.title: What He came to do
days.word: Good news for the poor, freedom for the captive, sight for the blind. This is His mission, and you are on the list.
days.step: Name one place you need Him to bring freedom.

days.title: He welcomes sinners
days.word: The Father runs to meet the one coming home. There is no shame He will not cover, no distance He will not close.
days.step: If you have wandered, say quietly: "Father, I am coming home."

days.title: He laid down His life
days.word: He carried what was yours to carry. The punishment that brought you peace was on Him. It is finished.
days.step: Thank Him for what He bore so you would not have to.

days.title: He is alive
days.word: The tomb is empty. Death did not win. The life He offers is not a better idea, but a risen Person you can know.
days.step: Ask Him to make Himself real to you, and then follow Him.

title: The Sermon on the Mount
subtitle: Six days in the teaching that turns the world upside down: the life Jesus blesses.
forWhom: For anyone learning the way of Jesus

days.title: Blessed are the poor
days.word: The kingdom belongs to the empty-handed, the mourning, the meek. What the world overlooks, Heaven crowns.
days.step: Which blessing do you most need to hear today? Sit with it.

days.title: Salt and light
days.word: You are not meant to blend in, but to season and to shine, so people see good works and glorify your Father.
days.step: Do one small good work today where someone will see it and be warmed.

days.title: The heart of the law
days.word: Jesus goes past behavior to the heart: anger, contempt, unreconciled relationships. He wants the root healed, not hidden.
days.step: Is there someone to be reconciled with? Take the first step toward peace.

days.title: Love your enemies
days.word: Anyone can love their friends. The children of the Father love even those who wrong them, because He does.
days.step: Pray, by name, for someone who has hurt you.

days.title: Do not worry
days.word: Your Father feeds the birds and clothes the fields. Seek His kingdom first, and what you need will be added.
days.step: Name one worry, and hand it to Him out loud.

days.title: Build on the rock
days.word: Hearing is not enough; the wise build their house on doing His words. Storms come to every house; only one stands.
days.step: Choose one word of Jesus to actually do this week, not just admire.

title: Peace Over Anxiety
subtitle: Six days of Scripture for a racing heart: the peace of God that guards you.

days.title: Do not be anxious
days.word: Anxiety is not defeated by trying harder to relax, but by turning every care into prayer. Then a peace beyond understanding stands guard.
days.step: Write down what you are anxious about, then pray each item by name.

days.title: Cast your cares
days.word: You were never meant to carry it all. Cast the whole weight on Him, because He cares for you, personally.
days.step: Physically open your hands as you give Him one heavy thing.

days.title: He is with you
days.word: Fear not, for I am with you. Not "figure it out," but "I am with you." His presence is the answer to your fear.
days.step: Breathe slowly and say: "You are with me. I am not alone."

days.title: Come to Me
days.word: Jesus does not add to your burden; He invites the weary to rest. His yoke is easy, His burden light.
days.step: Come to Him tired, exactly as you are, and rest for one minute.

days.title: A quiet trust
days.word: The Shepherd leads you beside still waters and through the valley. You lack nothing, even here.
days.step: Read the whole psalm slowly, as a prayer over your own life.

days.title: Peace I leave with you
days.word: His peace is not like the world’s fragile calm. It holds when everything shakes. Let not your heart be troubled.
days.step: Receive His peace as a gift, not a feeling to manufacture.

title: Grief and Hope
subtitle: Six days to grieve honestly and be held: God is near to the brokenhearted.

days.title: He is near
days.word: God does not stand at a distance from your sorrow. He is near to the brokenhearted, close to the crushed in spirit.
days.step: Tell Him honestly how your heart is. He can hold all of it.

days.title: Jesus wept
days.word: At a grave, the Lord of life wept. Your tears are not weakness or lack of faith; they are love, and He shares them.
days.step: Give yourself permission to grieve. He is weeping with you.

days.title: A refuge
days.word: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble. When the earth gives way, He does not.
days.step: Name Him as your refuge for today, one hour at a time.

days.title: Lament is allowed
days.word: Even in the ashes, the writer remembers: His mercies are new every morning. Hope and grief can share the same breath.
days.step: Write one honest line of lament, then one line of hope.

days.title: The God of comfort
days.word: He comforts us so that, one day, we can comfort others with the comfort we received. Nothing is wasted.
days.step: Let yourself be comforted today, without rushing to be strong.

days.title: Every tear
days.word: A day is coming when He will wipe every tear, and death will be no more. This grief is real, but it is not the end.
days.step: Look up and say: "Come, Lord Jesus. Make all things new."

title: The Freedom of Forgiveness
subtitle: Five days to release what you were never meant to carry, as you have been forgiven.

days.title: Forgiven much
days.word: We forgive not because the wrong was small, but because we have been forgiven so much. Grace received becomes grace given.
days.step: Remember one way God has forgiven you. Let it soften your heart.

days.title: Seventy times seven
days.word: Forgiveness is not a single event but a road you walk. When the pain returns, you forgive again.
days.step: Name the person. Say: "I choose to forgive, again."

days.title: Release the debt
days.word: To withhold forgiveness is to lock yourself in the prison meant for them. Christ hands you the key.
days.step: Picture handing the debt to God. It is His to settle, not yours.

days.title: Not revenge, but rest
days.word: You do not have to make it right by force. Leave room for God’s justice, and overcome evil with good.
days.step: Do one small good thing today instead of rehearsing the wound.

days.title: Freed to love
days.word: When bitterness is put away, tenderness returns. Forgiveness is how the heart is set free to love again.
days.step: Ask God to free your heart, and to bless the one who hurt you.

title: Psalms of Comfort
subtitle: Seven days in the prayer book of the Bible, words for when your own run out.
forWhom: For every season of the soul

days.title: The Shepherd
days.word: The most beloved psalm, because it is true: He leads, He restores, He is with you, even in the valley.
days.step: Pray it in the first person, slowly, over your own life.

days.title: My refuge
days.word: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High rests in the shadow of the Almighty. Under His wings you find refuge.
days.step: Name the fear you are sheltering from, and take refuge in Him.

days.title: Waiting on the Lord
days.word: One thing I ask: to dwell in His house. Wait for the Lord; be strong; let your heart take courage.
days.step: Wait quietly for one minute, asking only to be near Him.

days.title: Out of the depths
days.word: From the depths I cry to You. With the Lord there is steadfast love and full redemption. He hears.
days.step: Cry out honestly from wherever you are today.

days.title: Bless the Lord
days.word: Forget not His benefits: He forgives, heals, redeems, crowns you with love, satisfies you with good.
days.step: List three ways He has been good to you, and thank Him.

days.title: Search me
days.word: You are fully known and fully loved. He knit you together and never leaves. There is nowhere His love cannot reach.
days.step: Pray verse 23: "Search me, O God, and know my heart."

days.title: Everything that has breath
days.word: The psalms end in praise. When comfort has done its work, the heart lifts its head and worships.
days.step: Offer Him one line of praise, out loud, with whatever breath you have.

title: Joy in Philippians
subtitle: Six days in Paul’s letter of joy, written from prison: joy that circumstances cannot steal.

days.title: Confident of this
days.word: He who began a good work in you will carry it to completion. God does not abandon what He starts.
days.step: Thank God for one way He is still at work in you.

days.title: To live is Christ
days.word: When Christ is your life, even loss becomes gain. Nothing can truly threaten a heart anchored in Him.
days.step: Ask: what would it mean today for Christ to be your life?

days.title: The mind of Christ
days.word: He emptied Himself, took the form of a servant, humbled Himself to death. The way up in the kingdom is down.
days.step: Do one hidden act of service, expecting nothing back.

days.title: Pressing on
days.word: Forgetting what lies behind, straining forward. You are not defined by your past, but drawn by your calling.
days.step: Name one thing behind you to release, and press forward.

days.title: Do not be anxious
days.word: Rejoice always, and turn worry into prayer. The peace of God will guard your heart and mind in Christ.
days.step: Rejoice on purpose today, and pray instead of worrying.

days.title: I can do all things
days.word: The secret is contentment in Christ, in plenty or in want. His strength is enough for whatever today holds.
days.step: Say: "I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me," and mean it.

title: Loneliness and Belonging
subtitle: Six days for the ache of feeling alone: you are seen, known, and set in a family.

days.title: Seen by God
days.word: In her wilderness, Hagar names God "the One who sees me." You are not invisible. He sees you, right where you are.
days.step: Say quietly: "You see me." Let yourself be seen.

days.title: Never forsaken
days.word: He will never leave you nor forsake you. Even when people do, His presence does not withdraw.
days.step: Name one place you feel abandoned, and invite Him into it.

days.title: Set in a family
days.word: God sets the lonely in families. Belonging is His gift, not something you must earn or manufacture.
days.step: Reach out to one person today, even a short message.

days.title: Known fully
days.word: You are fully known and still fully loved. Before a word is on your tongue, He knows it. This is intimacy, not surveillance.
days.step: Rest in being known. You do not have to explain yourself to Him.

days.title: A friend who stays
days.word: Jesus calls you friend, not servant. He chose you, and He stays. The truest company is always near.
days.step: Talk to Jesus like the friend He is, out loud.

days.title: One body
days.word: You are a member of a body that needs you. Your presence is not optional; you belong, and you are missed when absent.
days.step: Take one small step toward the family, in person or in the app.

title: Purpose and Calling
subtitle: Six days on why you are here: made on purpose, for good works prepared in advance.

days.title: Made on purpose
days.word: You were knit together with intention. Your life is not an accident; it is authored. You are His workmanship.
days.step: Thank God for making you on purpose, exactly as you are.

days.title: Prepared in advance
days.word: You are created for good works God prepared beforehand. Your calling is not a puzzle to solve but a path to walk.
days.step: Do one good work today that is right in front of you.

days.title: Faithful in little
days.word: Purpose is found in faithfulness, not fame. Be faithful in the small, and the larger is entrusted in time.
days.step: Choose one small thing to do faithfully, without applause.

days.title: His to establish
days.word: You plan your way, but the Lord establishes your steps. You can move forward without seeing the whole map.
days.step: Commit one decision to Him, and take the next honest step.

days.title: For such a time
days.word: You are placed here, now, on purpose. This time and place are your assignment, not your accident.
days.step: Ask: what is mine to do in this season, with what I have?

days.title: To love and be sent
days.word: Above every task, your calling is to love God and love people. Every purpose grows from this root.
days.step: Love one person well today. That is calling fulfilled.

title: Waiting on God
subtitle: Five days for the in-between: how to wait with hope when the answer has not come.
forWhom: For anyone in a season of waiting

days.title: Renewed strength
days.word: Those who wait on the Lord renew their strength. Waiting is not wasted; it is where new strength is grown.
days.step: Name what you are waiting for, and give the timing to Him.

days.title: Be still
days.word: Be still, and know that He is God. Stillness is not passivity; it is trust that He is working when you cannot.
days.step: Sit still for one minute, unhurried, before Him.

days.title: His timing is good
days.word: He makes everything beautiful in its time. What feels late to you is not late to Him.
days.step: Release one worry about "when," and trust His timing.

days.title: Hope does not disappoint
days.word: Suffering produces endurance, endurance character, character hope. And this hope does not put us to shame.
days.step: Let today’s waiting do its slow, good work in you.

days.title: Wait with courage
days.word: Wait for the Lord; be strong, and let your heart take courage. You are not waiting alone or in vain.
days.step: Take heart. Say: "I will wait, and I will trust."

title: The Gospel of John
subtitle: Seven days through the Gospel of belief: that you may know Jesus is the Christ, and have life.
forWhom: For anyone ready to read a whole Gospel

days.title: The Word
days.word: In the beginning was the Word. Light shines in darkness; grace and truth come in the flesh, full of the Father.
days.step: Read John 1 slowly. Underline what you learn about Jesus.

days.title: Born again
days.word: You must be born again, from above. God so loved the world that whoever believes in the Son has eternal life.
days.step: Ask God for new life from above, wherever you are today.

days.title: Living water
days.word: At a well, Jesus offers a thirsty woman water that never runs dry. He meets you in your ordinary day.
days.step: Bring one honest thirst to Jesus and ask Him to satisfy it.

days.title: The bread of life
days.word: I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger. He is the sustenance your soul was made for.
days.step: Come to Him hungry, and be fed.

days.title: The good shepherd
days.word: The good shepherd knows His sheep and lays down His life for them. His voice can be trusted; His care is total.
days.step: Listen for His voice, and follow one nudge of it today.

days.title: The way, the truth, the life
days.word: Do not let your heart be troubled. Jesus is the way to the Father; to see Him is to see God.
days.step: Let one troubled place in your heart rest in Him.

days.title: That you may believe
days.word: The tomb is empty; the risen Jesus meets doubt with mercy. These are written so that you may believe and have life.
days.step: Say with Thomas: "My Lord and my God." Then follow Him.

title: The Generous Life
subtitle: Five days in the way of open hands: a life that gives, because everything was first a gift.
forWhom: For anyone learning to hold things loosely

days.title: Freely you received
days.word: Freely you have received; freely give. Generosity is not loss but the natural overflow of grace.
days.step: Give one thing away today, small or large, freely.

days.title: More blessed to give
days.word: It is more blessed to give than to receive. The open hand is where joy is found, not the closed fist.
days.step: Do one generous act expecting nothing back.

days.title: A cheerful giver
days.word: God loves a cheerful giver, and supplies you so you can be generous in every way. You will not run dry by giving.
days.step: Give cheerfully, not grudgingly, from what you have.

days.title: Treasure in heaven
days.word: Where your treasure is, there your heart will be. Generosity moves your heart to where it truly belongs.
days.step: Move one bit of treasure toward heaven today, quietly.

days.title: The widow’s gift
days.word: She gave two small coins, and Jesus said she gave the most. God measures generosity by love, not amount.
days.step: Give what is yours to give, however small, in love.
